summary: Valuence Merger Corp. I, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting that its board approved a one-month extension of the deadline to consummate an initial business combination, moving it from October 3, 2026 to November 3, 2026. This is the sixth of ten available monthly extensions, with the outside date extendable to March 3, 2027. The company deposited an additional $13,897.14 into its trust account to fund the extension. No business combination target, deal terms, advisor, or shareholder vote was disclosed. Watch for redemption levels and whether a definitive combination agreement is announced before the extensions expire.
